summary.text: Jodi Nelson is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as businesswoman.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jodi Nelson's House tenure as beginning in 2021, and its campaign contribution history shows general-election wins in Rockingham 6 in 2021 and in Rockingham 13 in 2024.
She was assigned to the Children and Family Law Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
